svg.title: Mika, in a comic old woman's mask, holding out a bowl
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Apulian red-figure krater Würzburg H 5697, c. 370 BCE, a scene from Aristophanes' Women at the Thesmophoria; traced from a photograph by ArchaiOptix (CC BY-SA 4.0), changed. This drawing is CC BY-SA 4.0.
